one_line: Earliest remembered Chahamana ruler of Shakambhari, linked to the Sambhar salt lake in early Rajput tradition.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean and athletic with a royal yet frontier-warrior build
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-full lips, sharp jawline, wheatish to light-brown north Indian complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm but alert eyes with a default expression of composed determination and understated pride.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a high, compact topknot (small warrior-style bun) at the back of the crown, sides smooth and tidy; a narrow, plain gold circlet sits low on the forehead, and a slim saffron cloth band is tied over it at the back.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length cotton anga (tunic) in muted off-white with a subtle woven border, belted at the waist with a broad maroon cloth sash; over this is a sleeveless quilted cotton coat in deep indigo, lightly padded, with simple geometric stitching and a narrow red edging, evoking early-medieval Rajasthan; his lower garment is a tightly wrapped dhoti-style cloth in dusty ochre, pleated neatly in front and ending just above the ankles; on his feet are sturdy brown leather sandals with straps; his shoulders and upper chest are crossed by twin leather straps holding a small round steel-gray buckler on his back; jewellery is modest but royal: a pair of small gold stud earrings, a single flat gold torque-like necklace, and a simple signet-style ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A straight, single-edged early-medieval Indian sword (similar to an early khanda but narrower), with a plain iron blade, slightly flared tip, and a simple crossguard; the hilt is wrapped in dark brown leather and has a small red tassel at the pommel, carried in a plain brown scabbard hanging from his maroon cloth belt, and in his left hand he often holds a small cloth pouch of salt crystals, symbolising the Sambhar lake.

ref_desc: Vasudeva of Shakambhari is a mid-30s, wheatish-complexioned Rajput king with an oval face, short beard, black hair in a high topknot under a gold circlet and saffron band, wearing an off-white tunic, deep indigo sleeveless padded coat, dusty ochre dhoti, maroon sash, brown leather sandals and straps, carrying a narrow straight sword with red-tasseled hilt and a small salt pouch, in a palette of off-white, deep indigo, maroon, dusty ochre and brown leather.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Vasudeva of Shakambhari: a mid-30s, lean but strong north Indian king with an oval face, wheatish complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, his default expression calm, composed and determined. His thick black hair is gathered into a high, compact topknot at the back of the crown, sides smooth, with a narrow plain gold circlet low on his forehead and a slim saffron cloth band tied over it at the back. He wears a knee-length off-white cotton tunic with subtle woven borders, belted tightly by a broad maroon cloth sash, over which sits a sleeveless, lightly quilted deep indigo cotton coat with simple geometric stitching and narrow red edging. His lower garment is a neatly pleated, ankle-length dusty ochre dhoti-style wrap, and he has sturdy brown leather sandals. Two brown leather straps cross his chest to support a small round steel-gray buckler on his back, and he has small gold stud earrings, a single flat gold torque-like necklace, and a simple signet ring on his right hand. At his waist hangs a plain brown scabbard containing a narrow straight early-medieval Indian sword with a simple crossguard, iron blade and dark brown leather-wrapped hilt with a small red tassel at the pommel, while his other hand holds a small cloth pouch of salt crystals. Use a restrained palette of off-white, deep indigo, maroon, dusty ochre and brown leather details, and present him front and slightly turned so all costume elements, weapon and accessories are clearly visible for consistent redrawing.
